ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are three circular glass containers of the same style, labeled SO₂, CH₄, and NCl₃ respectively. The problem states that the three containers have the same volume, the corresponding gas mass in each container is 10.0 g, and the temperature is all maintained at 298 K. Reasoning: Leakage through a small hole can be compared according to the law of gas effusion. Under conditions of the same temperature and the same small hole, the rate of pressure decrease caused by gas effusion is proportional to the initial pressure divided by the square root of the molar mass, that is, rate ∝ P_initial / √M. Since the three containers have the same volume, the same temperature, and the same gas mass, the initial pressure P_initial = nRT/V = (m/M)RT/V, therefore P_initial ∝ 1/M. So the pressure decrease rate ∝ 1/(M√M) = 1/M^(3/2). Comparing molar masses: CH₄ ≈ 16 g/mol, SO₂ ≈ 64 g/mol, NCl₃ ≈ 120 g/mol. The molar mass of CH₄ is the smallest, therefore 1/M^(3/2) is the largest, and the pressure decreases fastest.

raw_record.question_text: Three glass containers of identical volume each contain 10.0 g of a different gas: $SO_2$, $CH_4$, and $NCl_3$. The temperature of all three flasks is held constant at 298 K. If a small, pinhole-size leak is drilled into each container, which gas would experience the fastest pressure decrease?

method.method_draft: First identify the three gases shown in the image: SO2, CH4, and NCl3. From the text, note that each flask has the same volume, same temperature, and the same 10.0 g mass of gas. Calculate or compare molar masses. Since the pinhole effusion-driven pressure drop scales as initial pressure divided by sqrt(molar mass), and initial pressure for equal masses scales as 1/molar mass, rank gases by 1/M^(3/2). CH4 has the lowest molar mass, so its flask experiences the fastest pressure decrease.

推理：小孔泄漏可按气体逸出规律比较。温度相同且小孔相同条件下，气体逸出导致的压力下降速率与初始压力除以摩尔质量平方根成正比，即 rate ∝ P_initial / √M。由于三个容器体积相同、温度相同、气体质量相同，初始压强 P_initial = nRT/V = (m/M)RT/V，因此 P_initial ∝ 1/M。所以压力下降速率 ∝ 1/(M√M) = 1/M^(3/2)。比较摩尔质量：CH₄ ≈ 16 g/mol，SO₂ ≈ 64 g/mol，NCl₃ ≈ 120 g/mol。CH₄ 的摩尔质量最小，因此 1/M^(3/2) 最大，压力下降最快。
